routes.name: Varzia relics, as Gunsen Prime

rows.label: Aya

groups.activity: buy the Gunsen Prime relics she stocks, 1 Aya each
groups.meta: only while Gunsen Prime is in Prime Resurgence

live.text: vaulted; only during her Prime Resurgence

rows.label: Gunsen Prime relics
rows.note: buy extra Blade relics: every one carries it as the Rare

conditions: Her stock rotates away; relics and Aya you hold never expire.
Vaulted relics and the parts themselves still trade between players.
bonuses: Varzia is also in the Market's Prime Resurgence tab.

rows.label: Gunsen Prime Blueprint
rows.note: Lith C11 or Lith L6 or Lith N16 or Meso F5 or Neo C4 or Neo P6 or Neo Z10 or Axi P9, Common: 25.33% Intact

rows.label: Gunsen Prime Handle
rows.note: Meso P15 or Meso W4 or Neo B9 or Neo K7 or Neo T7 or Axi S19 or Axi T12, Uncommon: 20% Radiant

rows.label: Gunsen Prime Blade
rows.note: Lith G10 or Lith G13 or Meso G5 or Meso G10, Rare: 10% Radiant

conditions: Refine Rare relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces each); leave Blueprint relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds to 16.67%.
Mission rewards never drop Resurgence relics; Varzia is the only source.
bonuses: Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
